name: CLI-Anything
description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
one_liner: A translator that takes an old-fashioned command-line program and teaches an AI assistant exactly how to operate it, so the AI can run tools it was never built for.
buyer: An IT consultant hired to connect a mid-size company's old internal command-line tools to the company's new AI assistant rollout.
business_use_cases: An IT consultancy charges a flat fee per legacy tool to make it 'agent-ready' for a client's internal AI assistant.
A SaaS vendor wraps their own existing CLI product with this so customers can operate it through chat instead of memorizing commands.
A marketplace lists pre-wrapped, agent-ready versions of popular open-source CLI tools and takes a cut of each sale.

money_ideas.idea: Per-tool wrapping fee charged to companies with internal CLI software
A subscription marketplace for ready-made agent wrappers of popular tools

steal_this: Wrap one boring internal tool a local business already depends on, demo it running from plain English, and sell that demo as proof you can do the rest of their stack.
